hero.headline: Pickleball: rallies you can join on day one
hero.sub: A smaller court than tennis, a slower ball than badminton. An easy sport for almost anyone to share.

what.heading: A net sport with paddles and a plastic ball
what.body: Pickleball is played on a badminton-sized court with solid paddles and a perforated plastic ball. The rules are simple and the ball moves relatively slowly, so first-timers can keep a rally going quickly.

why.heading: Why people fall for pickleball
why.sub: It’s easy to learn, fun with others, and light enough to fit into a busy week.

easy.title: Easy to learn
easy.body: Know the serve and a few basics, and you’re in a game. There’s no steep tennis-style learning curve.

social.title: Built for groups
social.body: Doubles is the norm, so conversation and teamwork come naturally—great for clubs and meetups.

active.title: Gentle but active
active.body: The court is compact, yet you still move. Intensity scales with your partners and pace.

basics.heading: Just a few things to know
basics.sub: Understand the gear and court, and you can start your first game.

paddle.title: Paddle
paddle.body: A solid wood or composite paddle—no strings. Stable feel and easy control for beginners.

ball.title: Ball
ball.body: A plastic ball with holes. Air resistance keeps speed down and rallies longer.

court.title: Court
court.body: About the size of a badminton court with a center net. Play indoors or outdoors.

serve.title: Underhand serve
serve.body: Serve upward from below, diagonally into the opposite court. Most games start as doubles.

rally.title: Rallies and the kitchen
rally.body: Near the net is the non-volley zone (kitchen)—you can only hit after a bounce there. It cuts down on smash chaos and adds strategy.

score.title: Scoring
score.body: Games often go to 11 (win by 2). Local groups tweak details—check once before your first match.

beginner.title: Are starting a new sport
beginner.body: The skill barrier is low—it doesn’t feel like “only experts belong here.”

friends.title: Want meetups with friends
friends.body: Four players is the default, so plans are easy and the rally is the fun—not just the score.

families.title: Want something for families
families.body: Different ages can share the same court without feeling left out.

faq.sub: From rules and gear to court booking and venue rental—answers to the most common questions.
